trading_advice: Focus on earning at least 80 points to secure the Honda NSX-R GT, a highly desirable car. If you can reach 160 points, the #2 Ford GT40 is a valuable reward. The DeBerti Ford Mustang GT at 20 points is relatively easy to obtain, while the 2021 MINI John Cooper Works GP at 40 points requires moderate effort. Prioritize these cars if you enjoy collecting rare vehicles. Since the Series 6 rewards are available until November 5, 2026, plan your gameplay to accumulate points steadily. Trading these cars may yield good returns later, but current market values are unknown.
